soil_texture_preference: Medium to Heavy (Loam / Clay loam / Vertisol)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Sensitive to severe waterlogging during tillering & terminal drought/heat at anthesis-grain fill; nutrient demanding
recommended_predecessors: Faba bean; Winter/Spring Chickpea; Lentil; Vetch-Oat; Processing tomato (irrigated); Bare/cultivated fallow
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Continuous wheat monoculture increases take-all/Fusarium root rot & wild oat grass weeds; lowers N/SOC
authoritative_sources: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998); FAO EcoCrop / Sys et al. 1993; ITGC Algeria; ICARDA

key_soil_water_sensitivities: Similar to durum wheat; slightly higher frost resilience in higher interior plateaus
recommended_predecessors: Legumes (Faba bean / Chickpea / Lentil); Vetch-Oat; Vegetables
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Same cereal disease & grass-weed buildup as Durum wheat when grown consecutively
authoritative_sources: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998); ITGC Algeria; FAO EcoCrop

soil_texture_preference: Light to Medium-Heavy (Well-drained Loam to Clay loam)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Intolerant of prolonged waterlogging & pH < 5.5; superior drought escape & moderate salinity tolerance vs wheat
rotational_role: Drought-resilient cereal / livestock grain-straw base in drier southern communes (e.g. Tamlouka/Ain Makhlouf)
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Consecutive cereals amplify foliar/root diseases & deplete fertility (though barley slightly less sensitive than wheat)
authoritative_sources: FAO-56; FAO EcoCrop; FAO-29 Salinity; ITGC Semi-Arid Algeria

soil_texture_preference: Medium to Heavy (Deep structured Loam / Silt loam / Clay loam)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Very sensitive to drought at flowering/pod-set (high Ky) & prolonged waterlogging; Orobanche crenata parasite risk
rotational_role: Premier N-fixing broadleaf break crop (approx 100-200 kg N/ha reported in Med lit); improves clay structure
recommended_predecessors: Durum wheat; Barley; Soft wheat; Irrigated tomato
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Short (<3-4 yr) faba bean return accelerates broomrape (Orobanche) and chocolate spot (Botrytis) / Ascochyta
authoritative_sources: FAO-56; ITGC/MDPI Algeria pulse trials; FAO EcoCrop

soil_texture_preference: Light to Medium Clay Loam (Good drainage essential)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Highly sensitive to waterlogging & compacted wet clay; requires Ascochyta-tolerant & cold-tolerant cultivars for winter sowing
rotational_role: High-yield legume break crop replacing bare fallow or spring chickpea where winter blight resistant seed exists
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Continuous chickpea or <3 yr return risks severe Ascochyta rabiei & Fusarium wilt
authoritative_sources: ICARDA-ITGC Winter Chickpea Program; FAO-56; Sys et al. 1993

key_soil_water_sensitivities: Escapes severe winter cold/wetness but vulnerable to Spring-Summer terminal heat/drought & shallow seedbed drying
rotational_role: Flexible late-season legume break crop after wet winter blocks autumn planting
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Continuous chickpea or <3 yr return risks Fusarium wilt & Ascochyta

soil_texture_preference: Light to Medium (Free-draining Loam / Sandy loam; avoids heavy wet clay)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Extremely sensitive to waterlogging & heavy impermeable soils (common in Seybouse depressions)
rotational_role: Drought-adapted legume break crop better suited to lighter drier plains (e.g. Ain Rekada / Oued Zenati / Tamlouka) than wet bottoms
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Continuous lentil <3 yr builds up Ascochyta lentis / Fusarium & broomrape
authoritative_sources: FAO EcoCrop; ICARDA; Sys et al. 1993

key_soil_water_sensitivities: Poor drainage slows early growth; timing cut before weed seed shed is critical for grass weed suppression
rotational_role: Best-proven Algerian fallow replacement: fixes N; adds residue/SOC; breaks cereal weeds & feeds sheep/cattle livestock
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Heavy consecutive oat share reduces cereal break benefit vs pure broadleaf legume; must monitor grass weeds
authoritative_sources: ITGC / REFORMA / CIHEAM ArimNet Algeria; FAO-56 Forage

soil_texture_preference: Deep structured Loam / Clay loam (good aeration)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Zero tolerance for rainfed Summer drought; sensitive to waterlogging, erratic moisture (blossom-end rot) & salinity >2.5 dS/m (Seybouse risk)
rotational_role: High-value cash break crop in Guelma-Bouchegouf perimeter; residual P/K & weed control often benefits subsequent wheat
recommended_predecessors: Durum wheat; Vetch-Oat; Fallow; Faba bean
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Continuous tomato / Solanaceae (<3-4 yr) causes severe Verticillium/Fusarium wilt, nematodes & Orobanche; incompatible immediately before/after Potato
authoritative_sources: DSA Guelma / Cahiers Agricultures Bouchegouf studies; FAO-56; FAO-29 Salinity

optimal_ph_range: 5.0-6.2 (acidic opt.; high scab risk at Guelma pH 6.8-7.5)
soil_texture_preference: Light friable Sandy loam / Loam (poor in heavy compacted Clay loam)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Shallow roots -> extreme moisture stress sensitivity; heavy clay deforms tubers; alkaline pH (>7.0) elevates common scab risk; salt-sensitive
rotational_role: High-input irrigated cash crop requiring careful rotation & loose soil management
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Never follow Tomato or Eggplant (shared Solanaceae pests/nematodes/late blight); needs >=3-4 yr Solanaceae gap
authoritative_sources: FAO-56; FAO EcoCrop; Sys et al. 1993

soil_texture_preference: Medium to Heavy deep soils (exploits deep clay moisture)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: High water demand during flowering/head-fill; summer heat >35C in Guelma requires supplemental irrigation or deep moisture reserve
rotational_role: Deep-taproot broadleaf break crop hypothesized for sub-humid northern plains
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Continuous sunflower <3-4 yr causes Sclerotinia rot & Orobanche cumana; deep moisture depletion can penalize subsequent wheat if Autumn rain is late
authoritative_sources: FAO-56; FAO AquaCrop; Algerian oilseed trials require local DSA check

soil_texture_preference: Well-drained calcareous slopes / foothills (intolerant of waterlogging)
key_soil_water_sensitivities: Heavy flat poorly-drained vertisols cause root asphyxia; hill orchards tolerate shallow stony soils
rotational_role: Permanent landscape tree anchor in foothill/mountain communes (Bouchekouf, Roknia) — NOT rotated annually
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Never recommend converting olive orchards into annual cereal rotations
authoritative_sources: DSA Guelma olive sector; FAO-56 Tree Crops; FAO EcoCrop

key_soil_water_sensitivities: Bare soil increases Winter erosion risk on slopes; low annual land productivity vs Vetch-Oat replacement
rotational_role: Traditional moisture-storage & weed-control baseline in semi-arid High Plains (Tamlouka/Oued Zenati); target for sustainable legume/forage replacement
incompatible_consecutive_risk: Repeating fallow reduces farm income without soil cover; soil erosion penalty on >5% slopes
authoritative_sources: ITGC / ICARDA / CIHEAM Algeria cereal-fallow literature
